name: WF-02 · Post-call → summary + staged CRM update + staged follow-up [orion-self-install v0.1.0]

parameters.formDescription: Paste the transcript or your notes. {{AGENT_NAME}} returns a summary, a staged CRM update, and a staged follow-up draft. Nothing executes without your approval.

parameters.subject: ={{ 'Follow-up for ' + $json.contact + ' — staged by {{AGENT_NAME}}' }}
={{ 'Approve: CRM update for ' + $('Split sections').first().json.contact + '?' }}
parameters.message:
={{ '

Call Summary

' + $('Split sections').first().json.call_summary + '

Proposed CRM update (stage → ' + $('Split sections').first().json.proposed_stage + ')

' + $('Split sections').first().json.crm_update + '

A follow-up draft is waiting in your Gmail Drafts. Approve to write this update to your CRM. Decline and the CRM is untouched.

' }}

parameters.notesInFlow: This node targets the Attio template's shape by default — swap the URL/body for your HubSpot properties or other-CRM setup if you used a different path (see crm/README.md). Finish attaching the note to the contact's record + updating the pipeline entry (stage, next_action, next_action_due, last_touch, staged_draft_waiting=true) against your real CRM.

parameters.jsonBody: ={{ JSON.stringify({ harness_id: $vars.HARNESS_ID, signal_type: 'debrief_completed', occurred_at: $now.toISO(), payload: { workflow: 'wf-02', task_type: 'post_call_debrief', template_version: '0.1.0' } }) }}
parameters.notesInFlow: Disabled by default — enable only when the radio is on (status/status.json → sharing.status_signal_enabled true) and the three Variables BRIDGE_URL / HARNESS_ID / INSTALL_TOKEN are set from the same welcome-pack values. Sits on the approved branch only: it reports that a run completed, never content.
